description: Land Acquisition - Siruvilan, Valikamam South West, Sandilipay  D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing two land parcels to be acquired for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of the properties, claimants, and procedures for compensation claims, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
